foundational_geometry: the two collar sheets are restrictions of one oriented, time-oriented parent spin manifold with one global spinor bundle
induced_transmission: psi_-=rho(SpinLift(Lambda_cw)) psi_+; in a common parent coframe this is the identity transition up to the globally fixed spin sign
relative_Kosmann_operator: V_rel=V_core-U_cw^dagger V_wall U_cw; it vanishes for identical core/wall geometry and becomes nonzero only from an actual differential frame
residual_freedom: one overall spinor sign and common gauge transformations; neither is a relative family holonomy
self_adjointness: the internal seam Green forms cancel because the outward normals are opposite
